contract.goal: Record Johnny's launch-sequencing decision and re-sequence billing/entitlement work in the roadmap.
successConditions: Johnny's decision (A white-label first or B self-serve SaaS) quoted with date in docs/product-specs/index.md
Roadmap phase for STL-116/STL-28/STL-122 updated to match
stopConditions: A required change falls outside allowedPaths or inside forbiddenPaths (including .github/**, scripts/**, docs/contracts/**): stop and report; a maintainer PR or a new reviewed contract is required
Any production deploy, production env var change, DNS change, billing/payment action or destructive data operation is needed: stop for Johnny's explicit approval
A secret value would need to be read, printed or committed: stop; reference secrets by name only
Required CI checks cannot run (hosted CI unavailable) or fail for reasons outside this scope: report evidence, do not mark passed
Human-approval gate reached: The decision itself is Johnny-only; agent must not choose
requiredEvidence: PR body links the Linear issue and GitHub issue, lists changed files, and carries Factory-Contract-Hash and Factory-Attempt trailers
Exact commands run (npm run agent:check plus the scoped tests below) with results attached to the PR head SHA
All required checks green on the PR head: typecheck, lint, domain-tests, convex-tests, contractor-component, build
humanApprovalGates: The decision itself is Johnny-only; agent must not choose
